title: Privacy Policy | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: What data the DUMSKAYA DESIGN website collects, why, how long it is kept and your rights: enquiry form, e-mails and Google Analytics cookies.

parts.html: Data controller: Panorama Systems Florida LLC, 200 Kings Point Dr, Apt 1603, Sunny Isles Beach, FL 33160, USA. DUMSKAYA DESIGN interior design studio: Súkennícka 1, 821 09 Bratislava, Slovakia. Email: irina@dumskaya-design.com, phone: +421 918 17 77 85.

blocks.text: What data we collect and why

parts.html: When you submit the request form, we receive your name, phone number or email address, and the text of your message. We use this data solely to respond to your request and prepare a proposal (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — steps taken prior to entering into a contract).
If you email us or message us on WhatsApp or Telegram, we receive the information you provide in your message and use it to reply.
Requests from the website are delivered to us via Telegram. The website is hosted on a Hetzner server in the European Union. Your data is not sold or shared with third parties for advertising.

To understand traffic, we count page views from the server log and clicks on our phone numbers, e-mail address and messengers — without cookies or third-party services. Only totals are kept: how many visitors and clicks there were and on which pages.

If the message in an enquiry is written in neither Russian nor Ukrainian, its text (without your name and contact details) is sent to a machine translation service so that we receive a Russian translation. The service uses the text only for translation.
Requests are kept for no longer than 24 months after our last communication, unless a contract has been concluded between us. Contract-related data is retained for as long as required by Slovak law.

The website uses Google Analytics via Google Tag Manager to understand which pages are useful to visitors. These cookies are loaded only after you give your consent in the banner. You can change your choice or withdraw your consent at any time: the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of every page opens the banner again.

You can request access to your data, its correction or deletion, restrict or object to its processing, and receive your data in a machine-readable format. Write to irina@dumskaya-design.com. You can file a complaint with the Úrad na ochranu osobných údajov Slovenskej republiky (the Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic, dataprotection.gov.sk).
